name: Cities, blue lanes & Sahara
title: 5-Day Casablanca to Marrakech Tour
description: A compact cross-country journey through Chefchaouen and Fes, with a night near the dunes of Merzouga.
pace: Fast-paced, with several long driving days. Add nights in Fes and Marrakech for more time to explore; arrival in Casablanca the day before is recommended.
itinerary: Atlantic arrival, blue-city evening
Leave Casablanca early and travel north to Chefchaouen. Settle in for an evening walk through the blue medina. This is primarily a travel day; arrival in Casablanca the day before is recommended.
From the Rif to the medina
Enjoy a little more time in Chefchaouen before continuing to Fes. Explore nearby lanes after check-in; a full guided city visit requires an additional night.
Across the Middle Atlas to the dunes
Travel south through the Middle Atlas and Ziz Valley toward Merzouga. Plan for a full day on the road, with the desert arrival and any sunset activities.
Valleys, gorges and southern kasbahs
Leave the desert and continue toward the Todra area and Ouarzazate. Pause for scenery where the day's distance allows, then settle into your overnight accommodation.
An earthen village and an Atlas crossing
Visit Ait Ben Haddou before crossing the High Atlas to Marrakech. Finish at your accommodation; avoid a same-day early departure flight.

name: A night at the desert's edge
title: 2-Day Mhamid Desert Tour from Marrakech
description: A short southern escape across the Atlas and through the Draa Valley to the desert around Mhamid.
pace: Very long driving days and an early start in both directions. This short route is for the Mhamid area, not the distant Erg Chegaga dunes. Choose extra days for a more relaxed desert version.
itinerary: Over the Atlas, into the Draa Valley
Depart Marrakech early, cross the High Atlas and continue south through Ouarzazate and the Draa Valley. Reach the Mhamid area for your agreed desert experience.
Desert morning, mountain homecoming
Enjoy the desert morning before beginning the long return to Marrakech. Break the journey along the way and arrive in the evening. Do not plan a departure flight on this day.

name: The Morocco discovery circuit
title: 7-Day Grand Morocco Journey
description: Connect northern medinas, Sahara landscapes and Marrakech on a varied circuit, returning to Casablanca.
pace: An active overview of Morocco with long transfers between regions. Add days if you prefer slower mornings, more city visits or an extended desert stay.
itinerary: The Atlantic gateway and the blue north
Begin in Casablanca and head toward Chefchaouen. An early start gives you time to settle into the medina in the evening; late arrivals need a pre-tour night in Casablanca.
Blue lanes and a change of rhythm
Spend the morning exploring Chefchaouen before continuing to Fes for the night.
A day inside Fes
Allow a full day for Fes: its medina lanes, craft workshops and historic architecture. A local guide can be included in your personalised quote.
Mountain scenery and a desert night
Travel through the Middle Atlas and Ziz Valley toward Merzouga. Confirm your camp and desert activities during planning; arrival time determines the evening's rhythm.
Through the southern valleys
Continue west from the Sahara toward Ouarzazate, with stops around the Todra area as time allows. The landscape changes from open desert to valleys and earthen architecture.
Kasbah paths and the High Atlas
Explore Ait Ben Haddou, then cross the High Atlas to Marrakech for your final overnight.
Marrakech moments and your onward journey
Arrange time in Marrakech around your transfer to Casablanca. Share your flight time before booking so the final day's schedule includes a comfortable margin.

name: Rabat, Volubilis & the imperial route
title: 6-Day Imperial Cities and Mountains Tour
description: A journey through three imperial cities (Rabat, Fes, Meknes) with ancient ruins at Volubilis and crossing the Middle Atlas.
pace: Moderate pace with cultural focus. Cities receive unhurried time for guided exploration of medinas, palaces and craft traditions. Includes scenic mountain passes.
itinerary: Coastal charm and Rabat's stories
Travel north from Casablanca to Rabat. Explore the kasbah overlooking the Atlantic, the Mausoleum of Hassan II and the medina's quieter quarters. Overnight in Rabat.
Ruins and Meknes rhythms
Visit the Roman site of Volubilis before arriving in Meknes. Walk through the Imperial City's green gates and experience a more relaxed version of Moroccan grandeur. Stay overnight.
Fes in full: a medina immersion
Dedicate a full day to Fes. Navigate the UNESCO medina with time to explore craft workshops, historic fountains and the energy of one of North Africa's oldest cities.
Mountains and valley transitions
Leave the city and ascend into the Middle Atlas. Pass through cedar forests and Berber villages. Overnight in a mountain town or kasbah with views.
High Atlas crossing
Continue south, crossing passes and valleys. Stop in traditional Berber communities and enjoy views of snow-capped peaks. Arrive in Marrakech by evening.
Marrakech's souks and gardens
A morning or full day (depending on arrival time) to explore Marrakech's Jemaa el-Fnaa square, the Koutoubia Mosque and peaceful garden escapes before your onward journey.

name: Essaouira, Draa Valley & remote dunes
title: 8-Day Atlantic Coast and Deep Desert Tour
description: A route combining the windswept Atlantic charm of Essaouira with the palm-lined Draa Valley and distant desert camps near Erg Chegaga.
pace: A blend of coastal relaxation and long desert drives. Includes time for Essaouira's beaches and craft souk, plus extended Sahara time away from main roads.
itinerary: From the High Atlas to the sea
Depart Marrakech early, cross the High Atlas and descend to the Atlantic coast. Arrive in Essaouira by afternoon and explore the medina, harbour and seafood scene.
Essaouira's crafts and seafood
Morning exploring the arganite oil cooperative and woodwork souks. Afternoon walk along the ramparts and beach. Overnight in Essaouira.
Anti-Atlas foothills
Travel inland toward the Anti-Atlas. Stop in mountain villages and pass through valleys with Berber hamlets. Continue toward the Draa Valley edge.
Palm groves and southern routines
Enter the Draa Valley, one of Morocco's longest river systems. Travel past mud-brick kasbah towns and palm-fringed communities. Overnight in a traditional guesthouse.
Draa to Zagora
Continue south through increasingly sparse landscape. Reach Zagora and the famous 'Tombouctou 52 jours' marker. Overnight in Zagora with views of the desert edge.
Into Erg Chegaga and desert camp
Travel to a remote desert camp near Erg Chegaga dunes. Sunset camel trek, traditional dinner and a night under the stars in the vast Sahara.
Desert morning and return journey
Wake early for a desert walk or optional camel trek. Begin the return, passing through the Draa Valley again with fresh perspectives.
Anti-Atlas to Marrakech
Continue north through the Atlas, arriving back in Marrakech by evening with time to rest or explore a favourite quarter.

name: Tangier to Marrakech: complete coastal and desert axis
title: 10-Day Northern Morocco to Sahara Journey
description: A comprehensive route from Tangier southward, encompassing Mediterranean charm, imperial cities, Sahara oases and the High Atlas.
pace: A grand expedition with variety. Early days in the Rif and northern cities, mid-journey through desert camps, final days crossing mountain passes. Moderate daily driving with deep stops.
itinerary: Tangier: gateway and medina
Arrive in Tangier and explore the Kasbah, medina and oceanfront esplanade. Overnight in a riad near the port.
Tetouan's Spanish charm
Travel to Tetouan and explore its blue medina, less crowded than Chefchaouen. Discover craft workshops and the architectural blend of Spanish and Moroccan influences. Overnight.
Chefchaouen's blue-washed streets
Journey to Chefchaouen and spend time wandering the famous blue lanes. Visit the medina's central square and explore nearby hiking routes if time allows.
Fes: a full medina day
Travel south to Fes. Dedicate a full day to the UNESCO medina with its tanners' dyes, leather workers and ancient library. A local guide enriches the experience.
Middle Atlas and desert approach
Leave Fes and ascend through the Middle Atlas cedar forests. Continue toward Merzouga and the Ziz Valley. Arrive at a desert camp for sunset and overnight under stars.
Deep Sahara
A full day in the Sahara: sunrise trek, optional camel ride, village visit or simply the landscape. Overnight in the desert camp.
Todra Gorge and Ouarzazate
Travel west through canyon landscapes toward Todra Gorge. Continue to Ouarzazate with its kasbah architecture and film-set backdrop. Overnight.
Ait Ben Haddou earthen fortress
Visit the UNESCO village of Ait Ben Haddou. Explore the kasbah's pathways and ramparts with views over the Oueds Valley. Overnight nearby.
High Atlas crossing
Cross the High Atlas passes with alpine scenery. Stop in Berber villages and enjoy mountain air. Descend toward Marrakech.
Marrakech arrival and rest
Arrive in Marrakech with the evening free to settle in, rest from the journey or explore a favourite quarter. Time for reflection on the route's diversity.

name: Mountain Berber villages and Ouzoud Falls
title: 5-Day Atlas Mountains and Berber Culture Tour
description: A journey into the High Atlas to Berber villages, terraced valleys and the cascading Ouzoud Falls, returning to Marrakech with cultural immersion.
pace: Relaxed, with focus on walking and village interactions. Includes simple stays in family-run guesthouses. Some unpaved mountain roads add an authentic flavor.
itinerary: High Atlas foothills and Ait Bougmez
Depart Marrakech and drive into the High Atlas toward the Ait Bougmez Valley. This 'Happy Valley' is ringed by 4,000-meter peaks. Overnight in a guesthouse in the valley.
Valley walks and Berber hospitality
Spend a full day trekking through the Ait Bougmez Valley. Visit Berber communities, experience traditional agro-pastoral rhythms and share tea with locals. Simple mountain hotel overnight.
To Ouzoud Falls and Bin el Ouidane

Travel to Ouzoud Falls, one of Morocco's most spectacular cascades. Walk down to the base, swim if weather permits and explore the surrounding olive groves. Overnight nearby or at Bin el Ouidane lake.
Lake and mountain scenery
Morning exploring the turquoise waters of Bin el Ouidane Lake or further Ouzoud walking. Afternoon traveling back toward Marrakech via scenic Atlas passes.
Atlas to city
Complete the return to Marrakech with stops in mountain towns or small berber markets if time allows. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon.

name: Argan oil, fishing villages and coastal escapes
title: 7-Day Atlantic Coast and Argan Culture Tour
description: Explore Morocco's Atlantic coast from Marrakech northward, through argan oil heartland, coastal fishing villages and beach retreats to Casablanca.
pace: Leisurely coastal journey with beach time, culinary experiences and cultural encounters. Shorter daily drives allow for morning walks and afternoon ocean views.
itinerary: High Atlas to Essaouira
Cross the High Atlas from Marrakech to the Atlantic coast. Arrive in Essaouira and spend the afternoon and evening exploring the medina, seafood restaurants and harbor.
Essaouira's cooperative and souks
Visit an arganite oil cooperative run by women, learning traditional production methods. Explore the woodwork and crafts souks. Swim or beach walk in afternoon.
Coastal drive to Oualidia
Travel north along the coast, stopping in small beach villages. Arrive in Oualidia, known for its lagoon and oyster farms. Tour an oyster farm and enjoy fresh seafood.
Oualidia lagoon time
A full day for Oualidia: kayaking on the lagoon, beach walks or simply resting by the water. Discover local fishing communities and their daily routines.
El Jadida's coastal fortress
Journey north to El Jadida, a Portuguese coastal stronghold. Explore the fortified medina, underground cistern and rampart walks with Atlantic views. Overnight.
Azemmour river village
Visit the small river village of Azemmour south of El Jadida. Explore its narrow medina streets and riverfront. Continue north with coastal stops toward Casablanca.
Arrival in Casablanca
Reach Casablanca with time to explore the Hassan II Mosque, corniche or rest after the coastal journey. Overnight in Casablanca before onward travel or departure.

name: Deep Draa, Taliouine & High Atlas circuit
title: 12-Day Berber Heartland and Spice Route Journey
description: An extended journey through the Draa Valley's palm groves, Taliouine's saffron fields, the Anti-Atlas and High Atlas, with time for genuine village immersion.
pace: Slow and immersive. Long stays in villages, guided walks and time with local families. Includes some unpaved mountain roads and simple guesthouses. Ideal for explorers seeking depth.
itinerary: Over the High Atlas to the Draa
Depart Marrakech, cross the High Atlas and descend into the vast Draa Valley. Stop in the palm-fringed town of Agdz. Overnight in a valley riad or traditional kasbah.
Draa Valley culture and kasbahs
A full day exploring the Draa Valley: visit traditional kasbahs, meet Berber families and learn about date cultivation and irrigation. Walk among the palms and visit local markets.
South toward Zagora
Continue south through the Draa toward Zagora. Experience the landscape transition from lush valley to sparse desert. Visit the famous '52 jours à Tombouctou' marker signpost.
Zagora desert nights
Stay in Zagora with access to nearby Erg Chegaga dunes. Options for camel treks, desert walks or village visits in the sparse landscape. Two nights to fully absorb the Sahara.
Taliouine's saffron fields
Travel northeast toward Taliouine, famous for its saffron cultivation. Visit cooperatives and markets, meet saffron farmers and stay overnight in a mountain guesthouse.
Anti-Atlas Tafraoute
Journey to Tafraoute in the Anti-Atlas, ringed by dramatic rock formations. Explore the town and nearby painted rocks, a modern artistic intervention on the landscape. Overnight.
Anti-Atlas mountain walks
A day of trekking in the Anti-Atlas with Berber guides. Visit mountain villages, walk between rock formations and understand the region's nomadic heritage.
Back toward the High Atlas
Travel north from Tafraoute, crossing Anti-Atlas passes toward the High Atlas. Stop in small towns and Berber markets. Overnight in a mountain settlement.
Ait Bougmez valley immersion
Arrive in the Ait Bougmez Valley and stay with a Berber family or in a guesthouse embedded in the community. Walk through terraced fields and orchards. Learn about daily life.
Valley culture and cooking
A full day in Ait Bougmez: join women in food preparation (if welcomed), visit local schools or craft workshops, and walk to neighboring hamlets. Overnight with family or in guesthouse.
High Atlas passes and descent
Begin the return journey, traveling north through Alpine meadows and peaks. Overnight in a mountain town or pass settlement with vast views.
Return to Marrakech
Complete the journey by descending from the High Atlas back to Marrakech. Arrive with memories of deep Morocco and genuine encounters across villages and landscapes.

name: Northern coast, imperial cities, Sahara and coast return
title: 16-Day Complete Morocco Grand Circuit
description: An immersive grand circuit of Morocco encompassing the northern coast and Rif, imperial cities, the full Sahara experience and Atlantic beaches, returning to Casablanca.
pace: An epic journey with balanced pacing: time in cities, deserts, mountains and on coasts. Long enough to recover from drives and truly know places visited. Suited to travelers seeking Morocco's full spectrum.
itinerary: Casablanca gateway
Begin in Casablanca. Explore the Hassan II Mosque, ramparts and oceanfront corniche. Rest and acclimate. Overnight in Casablanca.
Tangier: the Strait crossing
Travel to Tangier and explore this cosmopolitan gateway. Visit the Kasbah museum and medina. Overnight in Tangier riad or hotel.
Tetouan's Spanish-Moroccan blend
Journey to Tetouan, exploring the medina that bridges Spanish and Moroccan cultures. Less crowded than Chefchaouen, with beautiful craft traditions.
Chefchaouen's blue medina
Arrive in Chefchaouen and spend a full day wandering the famous blue-painted streets. Visit the medina square, local cafés and surrounding hiking routes. Overnight.
Into Fes via Middle Atlas
Travel south, ascending through mountain passes and cedar forests. Arrive in Fes by late afternoon. Overnight.
Fes medina immersion
Dedicate a full day to Fes. Walk the UNESCO medina's labyrinthine streets, observe tanners' dyes, visit craft workshops and the historic Bou Inania Madrasa. Evening rest.
Fes to Sahara approach
Depart Fes and traverse the Middle Atlas. Drive through Ziz Valley toward Merzouga and the Sahara. Overnight at a desert camp.
Sahara deep immersion
A full day in the Sahara: sunrise trek, camel ride in dunes, visit Berber village or simply absorb the vastness. Overnight in the desert camp under stars.
Sahara to Todra
Travel west from Merzouga through Sahara landscapes. Arrive at the spectacular Todra Gorge, a narrow canyon carved by an oued. Afternoon walk in the gorge and overnight nearby.
Gorge and Ouarzazate
Morning exploring Todra further, then travel to Ouarzazate, Morocco's Hollywood. Explore the kasbah architecture and red-walled streets. Overnight.
Ait Ben Haddou UNESCO site
Visit the UNESCO earthen village of Ait Ben Haddou. Explore winding pathways, climb ramparts and photograph views over the Oueds Valley. Overnight in a guesthouse in or near the kasbah.
High Atlas crossing
Cross the High Atlas passes with dramatic Alpine scenery. Stop in Berber villages on the descent. Arrive in Marrakech by evening. Overnight.
Marrakech's heart
Explore Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its acrobats and food stalls. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque and peaceful Majorelle Garden. Overnight in a riad in the medina.
Marrakech to Essaouira
Travel to Essaouira on the Atlantic coast. Explore the seafront medina, ramparts and fishing harbor. Visit an arganite oil cooperative. Overnight in Essaouira.
Essaouira and coastal journey
Morning beach walk or swim in Essaouira. Afternoon traveling south toward Tafraoute in the Anti-Atlas through increasingly sparse landscape. Overnight in Tafraoute.
Anti-Atlas and return to Casablanca

A full Anti-Atlas experience: rock formations, painted rocks and mountain villages. Begin the return journey north toward Casablanca via scenic routes. Arrive in Casablanca by evening, completing the circuit.
